messages:
hana: Anyone else notice the nightly evals missed uploading per-sample traces/artifacts for several quantization experiments?

jordan: yep, spotted that on the dashboard this morning — large gap in the trace counts for q4 runs.

samir: saw a bunch of 403s in the runner logs. snippet: ```2026-03-18T08:12:14Z upload_artifact key=evals/q4/modelA/run-137/trace.json status=403 error=AccessDenied```

maria: interesting — retention can't be the issue if upload failed. looks like auth or presign expiry. which bucket were we using?

hana: target bucket was redwood-evals-prod, using CI-generated presigned URLs from the eval-runner job.

jordan: CI job history shows intermittent 403s around 08:12-08:20, then a flood of retries that eventually gave up. only affected a subset of workers (gpu-pool-3).

samir: possible causes: IAM role rotation, clock skew on workers, or presign TTL too short when queueing tasks. we should check runner clock and presign TTL logic.

devlin: quick repro idea: run a single quant job with --dump-trace, and force upload to debug bucket: `./eval-runner --model modelA --quant q4 --dump-trace --upload-bucket=redwood-evals-debug` then tail the uploader logs.

ci-bot: note: created ticket INF-1298 for intermittent artifact uploads; linked pipeline run 2026-03-18_08:00 (https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/2026-03-18_08:00)

maria: one more wrinkle — dashboard shows some runs that did upload traces, but the artifact schema version in them is v1 while the new reporting dashboard expects v2 fields (sample_id -> id, meta->context). mismatch could break downstream reporting even when upload succeeds.

hana: yeah we saw partial uploads where metadata schema didn't include `hardware_profile`. dashboard then treats whole run as invalid and hides per-sample metrics.

jordan: action plan: 1) short-term: re-run affected jobs to re-create traces and upload to debug bucket with extended TTL; 2) infra: add retry+exponential backoff + clock drift check in runner; 3) eval-harness: add artifact schema validator as a CI gating check; 4) console: make dashboard tolerant to schema v1->v2 mapping for a week.

samir: I'll own the runner fix and the clock check. starting a debug run now.

maria: I'll open a small PR to add a post-upload validation step that asserts schema version and required fields, and fails the job early if invalid.

devlin: I'll run the replays and upload to redwood-evals-debug, ping when done.

jordan: leaving a reminder to bump retention on debug bucket to 90d so we have time to inspect. also filing a small notif to eng-infra to review IAM rotation logs around that time.

hana: thanks — please post the re-run thread when you have the new artifact links. :thumbsup:
